title: Microsoft Edge: share tenant-approved work browsing history with Microsoft 365 Copilot Search
summary: The roadmap facts, sharing default and Edge policy details are supported. The briefing goes beyond the documentation by saying administrators cannot check the site scope locally and by extending eligibility to every Copilot-licensed work-account user; these statements need narrowing before publication.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes Edge sending IT-admin-selected work-related browsing history to Copilot.
claims.quote: Microsoft Edge can now send IT admin selected work related browsing history to Copilot to improve search relevance.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Copilot Search can show relevant results from the user's browsing history.
claims.quote: When a user searches for something on Copilot search, Copilot will also show results from browser history when relevant.

claims.quote: This policy controls whether browsing history in Microsoft Edge is shared with Microsoft 365 Copilot Search to provide more relevant search results.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: The policy page does not identify which Microsoft 365 Copilot licences are eligible for this feature.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Edge Copilot Search eligible licenses browsing history' and 'ShareBrowsingHistoryWithCopilotSearchAllowed eligible license pricing meter retention storage delete browsing history'; read the policy page and Copilot licensing/Search excerpts. No feature-specific eligible-SKU list was stated.

claims.where: controls[1]; Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not document a UI or automation control for selecting the tenant-approved sites shared by this Edge policy.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Edge Copilot Search approve sites administrator UI API Graph tenant browsing history' and 'ShareBrowsingHistoryWithCopilotSearchAllowed sites configure'; read policy, Stable/Beta notes, connector-extension page and Edge policy/Graph search excerpts. No site-selection control for this policy.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Administrators cannot check from their own configuration which sites are in scope, and the reach cannot be checked locally.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Edge Copilot Search approve sites administrator UI API Graph tenant browsing history' and 'ShareBrowsingHistoryWithCopilotSearchAllowed sites configure'; read policy, release notes and connector-extension page. None states that local scope inspection is impossible.
claims.fix: Remove 'administrators cannot check from their own configuration which sites are in scope' from Why it matters and 'so the reach cannot be checked locally' from Risk assessment. Keep the narrower statement that Microsoft Learn does not document how sites are approved at the time of writing (November 2026).

claims.claim: The policy page and release notes describe no feature-specific meter or charge.
claims.quote: Searched: 'ShareBrowsingHistoryWithCopilotSearchAllowed eligible license pricing meter retention storage delete browsing history'; read policy and feature passages in Stable/Beta notes, searched notes for meter/charge. They state no meter or charge for this feature.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: The policy page does not describe where the shared history is stored.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Edge Copilot Search browsing history actions stored retention'; read full policy and Edge privacy/Search excerpts. The policy gives no storage location; personal-account personalization and local History storage do not establish storage for this feature.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: The policy page does not describe how long shared history is retained.
claims.quote: Searched: 'ShareBrowsingHistoryWithCopilotSearchAllowed eligible license pricing meter retention storage delete browsing history' and 'Edge Copilot Search browsing history actions stored retention'; read policy and privacy excerpts. No retention period for this sharing was stated.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: The policy page does not describe whether shared history can be deleted.
claims.quote: Searched: 'ShareBrowsingHistoryWithCopilotSearchAllowed eligible license pricing meter retention storage delete browsing history'; read policy and Edge privacy excerpts. Local history deletion and personal-account privacy dashboard instructions do not document deletion of this shared history.

claims.claim: The cited sources do not describe this sharing feature taking actions.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Edge Copilot Search browsing history actions stored retention'; read roadmap, full policy, release-note feature passages and connector-extension page. These describe sharing/ranking, not autonomous actions; remote-browser actions are a separate feature.

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 Copilot extension captures activity only from administrator-approved applications.
claims.quote: The extension collects signals only from administrator-approved applications and doesn't track general web browsing.

claims.claim: The extension uses connector activity settings to map visited URLs to indexed item IDs.
claims.quote: To enable activity signals, you must configure activity settings on the connector so the system can map visited URLs to indexed item IDs.

claims.claim: The extension page does not say that its connector activity settings select the sites shared by Edge under ShareBrowsingHistoryWithCopilotSearchAllowed.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Edge Copilot Search tenant approved browsing history sites approval configure policy Graph API activity settings'; read full crossover-browser page and policy. The extension page requires an installed extension and never names ShareBrowsingHistoryWithCopilotSearchAllowed.

claims.claim: Every Copilot-licensed user signed in to Edge with a work account has sharing switched on unless they use the toggle.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Edge Copilot Search eligible licenses browsing history'; read policy and Copilot Search eligibility/licensing excerpts. They require an eligible licence; none states that every Copilot licence is eligible for this Edge feature.
claims.fix: Replace the second sentence of Why it matters with 'When the policy is not configured, users signed in to Edge with an Entra ID account and holding an eligible Microsoft 365 Copilot licence have sharing on by default, but can turn it off in Edge settings.' In the impact rationale, replace 'holding a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence' with 'holding an eligible Microsoft 365 Copilot licence'. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-policies/sharebrowsinghistorywithcopilotsearchallowed.
